nodes.causal_cutoff: All direction inputs available no later than the decision cutoff.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Any inconsistent or absent source-authorized direction state yields abstention.
nodes.output: call bias, put bias, or abstain

nodes.causal_cutoff: Contract lifecycle and selection fields available before selection.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Missing or tied eligibility state yields abstention.

nodes.abstention_behavior: Reject any incomplete, unavailable, not-yet-completed, or wrong-contract candle.
nodes.causal_cutoff: Exchange-defined completed daily candle for the selected option contract available before geometry is read.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Contract identity, exchange, or provider completion disagreement fails closed.
nodes.output: causally available completed selected-contract daily-candle event

nodes.causal_cutoff: Only completed selected-option candles through the decision cutoff.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Anchor ties or incompatible valid lines yield unknown.

nodes.causal_cutoff: Only completed authorized-chart candles through the decision cutoff.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Chart-source ambiguity, anchor ties, or incompatible lines yield unknown.

nodes.causal_cutoff: Only completed candles and geometry visible through the decision cutoff.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Ambiguous sequence or a missing protocol-compliant blinded annotation/adjudication trace yields unknown.

nodes.abstention_behavior: Emit unknown quality; do not substitute model consensus.
nodes.causal_cutoff: Only the completed decision-time candle context.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Annotator or dimension disagreement yields unknown unless resolved by the approved prospective adjudication protocol.

nodes.abstention_behavior: Emit no entry when any prerequisite or ordering state is unresolved.
nodes.causal_cutoff: Perception states and any admissible fill state available by the decision cutoff.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Only the pinned left preference is retained; every other simultaneous state abstains.
nodes.output: left entry, right entry, or abstain

nodes.causal_cutoff: Reference geometry must be fixed before entry and evaluated from causally available candles.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Reference, buffer, or gap ambiguity yields abstention.

nodes.causal_cutoff: Premium and lifecycle states available at each management decision without future path access.
nodes.conflict_behavior: Exit, runner, expiry, or roll ambiguity yields abstention and no synthetic continuation.

nodes.abstention_behavior: Record no outcome: future outcome observation is outside the approved source protocol and remains fail closed until separately measurable.
nodes.causal_cutoff: Available only after the relevant future path; prohibited from perception and decision inputs.
nodes.conflict_behavior: The approved source protocol cannot authorize future outcomes; any provider, lifecycle, reconstruction, or authorization ambiguity rejects the outcome row.
nodes.output: future outcome observation or rejected row
